# The Ice Hut

> Family-owned ice cream shop in Morinville, Alberta, Canada, serving premium Foothills Creamery ice cream since 1995. Known for 48 rotating flavours, famously generous scoops, milkshakes, sundaes, gluten-free options, and $2.25 Puppy Cones for dogs.

## Key facts

- Address: 9911 100 Street, Morinville, Alberta, T8R 1R4, Canada (about 20 minutes north of Edmonton)
- Phone: 780-819-9726
- Email: dawn@morinvilleicehut.ca
- Hours: Monday–Friday 4:00pm–9:00pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:00pm
- Founded: 1995, family-owned and operated
- Ice cream: premium Foothills Creamery (made in Alberta), 48 rotating flavours
- Popular flavours: peanut butter chocolate, New York cherry cheesecake, salted caramel
- Dietary: gluten-free options available
- Dog-friendly: Puppy Cone available for $2.25
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/morinvilleicehut/
